voice_design.note: ttv_v4 returns 422. text must be 100+ chars (else 422, no charge). design calls are free and return 3 previews. Save with POST /v1/text-to-voice; saved voices cannot be deleted with a restricted key and the account has a 30-voice slot limit, so save only 1 preview per character direction.

notes: stability for the v3/v4 family may only accept 0.0, 0.5 or 1.0 (Creative / Natural / Robust). Confirm with the first real call; if a fractional value is rejected use 0.5.
speed has no effect on clip length on v4; adjust tempo afterwards with ffmpeg atempo <= 1.15 if needed.
character-cost response header counts [tag] characters too. Sum it per call to track credits.
Max 5 concurrent requests. Turn automatic retries off.
Normalize decoded mp3 peaks to -1 dBFS before conversion.

why: Korean eleven_v4: [arrogantly]/[firmly] raised F0 enough to sound like a different speaker; [shouting]/[screaming]/[startled]/[alarmed]/[shocked] pushed F0 far up; [loudly] adds about +40~60 Hz; [commanding] also rises on lines ending with '!'; [warmly]/[proudly] raised F0 on new Voice Design voices.
[growling] produced takes whose transcript collapsed into moaning.
[whispers] is mostly unvoiced: F0 measurement and loudness normalization break, and preset lines must stay level-matched.
[low voice] sounds like a whisper (about 100 Hz on a male voice), not usable here.
[cheerfully]/[excited] are untested for these voices and likely to raise pitch; brightness should come from the voice design and wording, not tags.
rules: Tags are optional. Most preset lines use no tag; the voice itself carries the character.
Use at most one tag per line, only from the character's allowed list.
Every tagged line is an untested candidate: generate it with and without the tag and keep the take whose yin F0 median stays inside that character's untagged distribution.

Very short lines (one or two syllables) can be spoken twice in a single request. The script keeps every line at 5+ non-punctuation characters; still check takes with 10 ms RMS blocks and Whisper/scribe.
Do not judge STT mismatches on name+particle liaison alone; listen.

contrast.principle: Judge separation by order and gaps of v4 yin F0 medians measured on the same reference line, not by absolute bands. Target order (low to high): dotchan < gpichan < claudechan < grokchan < gemmini, with about 15 Hz or more between neighbours. Timbre and pace carry the rest of the contrast, especially where two voices sit close in pitch.
contrast.reference_line_ja: 作業が終わりました。結果を確認してください。

voice_design.description: Adult Korean woman in her mid twenties, Korean native speaker with a natural standard Seoul accent. Medium pitch, a little on the higher side of medium, with a soft, warm, rounded, lightly sweet timbre, slightly breathy but clear and close to the microphone. The gentle, bookish softness of a quiet reader with round glasses, the warm hush of a tea-time afternoon, like someone pouring tea while listening. Moderate, unhurried pace with smooth phrasing and gently falling, rounded sentence endings. Default emotion: kind, attentive and reassuring, like a considerate personal secretary speaking quietly in a calm office. Polite and friendly, never childish, no exaggerated cuteness, no vocal fry. Clean dry studio recording, no background noise, no music.
